text:
maria: heads up — saw a p95 jump (~2.1x) in the canary after the runtime v3.12.0 rollout, starting ~08:40 UTC. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/canary/cohort/8421
ashley: confirming — spike focused on requests that touch auth+rerank path, p99 also nudged up but much noisier. not seeing obvious cpu/gpu saturation.
tj: any correlated errors? 429s or auth failures?
maria: only latency, no 5xx or 429s. traces show more time in "request_lock" span.
jamal: interesting — v3.12.0 introduced the per-request sidecache lock to avoid concurrent cache writes (PR 5421). could be lock contention under certain fanout.
ashley: can we reproduce with a synthetic cohort? run a workload hitting auth->rerank flow with concurrency ~40 and batch sizes like prod.
maria: repro steps I used: ```
# quick repro (local canary repro harness)
export REDWOOD_ENV=canary
./repro_client --qps 200 --concurrency 40 --prompt-set auth_rerank_small.json
```
ashley: ran that, saw tail latency climb after ~90s. stack traces show many threads waiting on Mutex::lock at runtime/src/sidecache.rs:128
tj: good find. hypothesis: new sidecache lock serializes writes during KV cache population for long-lived sessions, causing queuing at p95. next step: bisect config change vs kernel change. is this sidecache change in runtime binary or config flag?
jamal: code change in runtime (binary). we can test by deploying a build that reverts PR 5421 or toggle the feature flag sidecache.lock=false (if canary has flag check).
maria: canary has flag toggle. I did a scoped toggle on 10% of canary traffic to false and p95 dropped back to baseline on that cohort within a minute.
ashley: nice — that's a quick mitigation. ops: shift remaining canary traffic to the cohort with flag=false and run extended sampling.
mar ia: (typo) maria: ops* — tagging @tj to handle traffic split. :thumbsup:
tj: on it — running traffic split to 10%->stable canary with flag=false, and opening rollback window if we don't see stabilization in 15m.
devops-bot: deploy change detected: canary config update by tj at 08:59 UTC — traffic split adjusted.
maria: while we stabilize, we should collect flamegraphs + lock contention counters. adding the repro harness with pcap/tracing: ```
./repro_client --qps 200 --concurrency 40 --trace=flame --out=/tmp/trace.tar
```
jamal: i'll add a short-term mitigation doc to the rollout checklist: 1) ensure sidecache.lock feature flag present and toggleable 2) measure kv-populate latency in preflight 3) add lock-free fastpath for cold misses (medium-term)
ashley: also notify support: customer-impact window is small but some tenants on heavy auth paths may have seen p95 blips. open a proactive escalation note.
maria: created support ticket #S-8893, message drafted to affected customers.
tj: if reverting is needed, we have rollback artifact v3.11.7 ready; rollback plan in runbook: `make rollback ARTIFACT=runtime:v3.11.7`
maria: next actions: jamal to prototype lock-free fastpath, ash to run 2hr canary with flag=false, tj to keep rollback window open for 45m, i'll keep customer comms updated.
jamal: ack, starting prototype branch now.
ashley: thanks team — summarizing in the incident doc and closing this channel when we have green metrics. :white_check_mark:
